title: Kamsin Gaye Zaeef
body:
kamsin gaye zaeef gaye naujawan gaye
manzil bahot kathin thi magar natawan gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ran mein aate hai ab khairiat nahi
mehsoos ho raha hai zameen aasman gaye
kamsin gaye zaeef gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
dene gawahi asha-duan-la-ilaah ki
islam par jo waqt pada bezaban gaye
kamsin gaye zaeef gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ko sughra karti hai shayad watan mein yaad
qaime se ran mein lete huwe hichkiyan gaye
kamsin gaye zaeef gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt e jihaad ye bhi tha ehsaas shaah ko
humlo ki daad kaun de sab khadradaan gaye
kamsin gaye zaeef gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
aelaan e fatha karte huwe sibte mustufa
sar kat gaya to bar sare nauke sina gaye
kamsin gaye zaeef gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad karbala se chale thay bukhaar mein
ta shaam phir bhi pehne huwe bediyan gaye
kamsin gaye zaeef gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
anwar ghame hussain ke sadqe mein ab talak
izzat hui naseeb hamein hum jahan gaye
kamsin gaye zaeef gaye...
author: Anwar Zahir
